An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''captain''' commanded a [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel|scout vessel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The captain's [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Ambush in the Fakir sector|ambushed]] a lone [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]], eventually defeating and capturing her. However, the [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]] was damaged, forcing the captain to take his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] to the [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|garrison]] on [[Flankers]]. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] had recently been evacuated due to the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]] going [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. While waiting for a relief force to rescue them, the captain and his men were [[Rescue of Lens Reekeene|attacked]] by a [[Green squad|Rebel force]] intent on rescuing Reekeene.<ref name="Missing" />
